##### Project general facts

Residence 110 is a ready premium property delivering an elevated cosmopolitan living experience. Developed by Select Group, a multidisciplinary developer with over two decades of industry-leading experience, this exquisite development features a selection of spacious one, two, and three-bedroom units. Exquisite architecture coupled with a modern, spacious design makes Residence 110 the perfect offering of premium residences, with a seamless connection to the city's most sought-after hotspots.

Residents enjoy a wealth of leisure and fitness options designed to enhance everyday living. A spacious fully equipped gymnasium, outdoor swimming pool with sun loungers, and changing facilities are available on the ground floor. Pedal enthusiasts can access the Meydan cycling circuit within metres from their doorstep, while outdoor runners can cruise along the Dubai Canal for their session, taking in the sites of Downtown Dubai. Every element is crafted to support an active and balanced lifestyle.

Refined architectural design coupled with uncompromising interior detail in all public areas sets a positive tone of elegance yet welcoming residential living. Perfectly balancing premium finishes with everyday comfort, each unit features fully equipped kitchens with premium white goods, prime glazing for optimal isolation, and large floor-to-ceiling windows inspiring a welcomed surge of natural light. All units comprise fully equipped kitchens with white goods, large ensuite bathrooms in master bedrooms, built-in wardrobes, and laundry cabinets.

##### Location description and benefits 

Nestled in the heart of Business Bay, this exceptional location offers minutes from the Dubai Canal and Downtown Dubai, together with swift access to Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road. Residence 110 sits in a truly privileged and convenient location, making accessing the city's most sought-after locations a breeze.

The location is distinguished by its strategic connectivity to key destinations. Dubai International Airport, Dubai Festival City, Dubai International Financial Centre, Dubai Mall, Dubai Opera, Burj Khalifa, and Dubai Design District are all within easy reach. The area's vibrant energy and world-class infrastructure make it an ideal choice for those seeking a dynamic urban lifestyle.

For those seeking a residence that embodies refined comfort, premium quality, and a prime Dubai address, Business Bay delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of strategic connectivity, world-class amenities, and a prestigious location makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of city living.
